name: Dynamic Voxel World with Chunked Meshing
definition: Managing a dynamic voxel world using thread-safe chunks, dirty tracking, and parallel meshing with a per-update budget.
summary: Dynamic Voxel World with Chunked Meshing manages dynamic voxel worlds by dividing them into fixed-size 3D grids meshed independently, setting itself apart through thread-safe dirty tracking, parallel meshing from padded snapshots, and per-update budgets to maintain frame rates.
